component_patterns.navbar: Sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-white/10 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl. Must include Logo, 3-5 key links, and 'Hire Me' CTA.
component_patterns.command_palette: ⌘K triggered. Glassmorphism overlay (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/40). Search input with JetBrains Mono. Keyboard navigable list of quick actions and page routing.
component_patterns.cards: 1px solid border (border-border). Dark card backgrounds with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1) and slight glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]). No heavy drop shadows.
component_patterns.buttons: Primary: Solid high-contrast text on solid background. Secondary: 1px border with transparent background, hover bg-white/10. Include micro-interactions on click.
component_patterns.chat_widget: Floating bottom-right. Circular button with icon. Opens an Apple-styled chat window with glassmorphism header, streaming text interface, and system prompt personality tailored to the founder.
component_patterns.founder_dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation (left aligned), 1px borders, dense data density. Floating bottom dock (MacOS style) for quick actions like 'New Post', 'New Message', 'Command'.
component_patterns.floating_dock: Bottom center of dashboard. Fixed position. Glassmorphism background. App-like icon buttons with tooltips on hover.

animation_specs.page_transitions: Smooth fade-in and subtle slide-up (10px) on initial mount.
animation_specs.hover_states: Color transition duration 200ms ease. Translate Y -2px for cards.
animation_specs.staggered_lists: Framer motion staggerChildren 0.1s for blog posts, projects, and dashboard items.
